verdict.rationale: A government business-filing registry could plausibly offer a public API with scoped credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web-based filing and search portals, and probes found no OpenAPI spec and no documented public API. The 'Authorized Users' UCC e-filing login is an adjacent access control, not issuable least-privilege API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
